def transform2(g, paint_walls=False):
    g=[list(r) for r in g]
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    maze=g[0][0]
    cols=[j for j in range(w) if any(g[i][j] not in (0,maze) for i in range(h))]
    c=min(cols); off=c-1; lw=w-off
    right=[[g[i][j] for j in range(off,w)] for i in range(h)]
    rows=[i for i in range(h) if any(v!=0 for v in right[i])]
    bs=[];cur=[rows[0]]
    for i in rows[1:]:
        if i==cur[-1]+1: cur.append(i)
        else: bs.append(cur);cur=[i]
    bs.append(cur)
    shp=[]
    for b in bs:
        r0=b[0]
        colj=[j for j in range(lw) if right[r0][j]!=0]
        col=right[r0][colj[0]]
        cells=[(i-r0,j) for i in b for j in range(lw) if right[i][j]!=0]
        shp.append((col,cells))
    out=[list(r[:off]) for r in g]
    for k,b in enumerate(bs):
        col,cells=shp[(k+1)%len(shp)]
        for dr,j in cells:
            if paint_walls or out[b[0]+dr][j]==0:
                out[b[0]+dr][j]=col
    return out
